However, Flare is also cowardly, as she begged Keyaru for forgiveness after the latter manages to ambush her. She tried to justify her actions by telling Keyaru that she only drugged him for his sake when it ending up going wrong for her. She is willing to offer Keyaru bargains such as money, noble status or even women. When she was about to impaled by a heated rod, Flare begged him to only harass her instead. When she sees Keyaru faint after healing Kureha, she immediately dismisses him as completely useless, and has to be told by her court mage that he has in fact performed some very high-level magic. Her arrogance is on full display once Keyaru strikes back against her, as even when she is completely at his mercy, she still behaves herself arrogantly towards him and insults him for being low-born, which only infuriates the Healer Hero even further.)

As Freia - present. After being brainwashed by Keyaruga, Freia is now completely loyal to him and genuinely in love with him. She is also far more kinder than her former self, as she treats Setsuna as a friend in spite of how her nation abuses demi-humans.

Ironically, she now displays a strong sense of justice and will be the first to claim that they have to save people whenever the Jioral Kingdom's forces abuse innocents. This amuses Keyaru to no end, as he knows what kind of person she used to be before this and feels like it's hypocritical for Freia to hold such views. Keyaru has noted that despite her memory being changed her personality is still the same in regards to how she views all other humans besides Keyaru and those she has come to care about, therefore she doesn't mind or hold it against him when he kills people who deserve it.

Becoming an amnesiac has made Freia more naive than before. Keyaru even has to teach her how to use her spells properly, since even though she retained her knowledge on how to cast them, all of her experience with their use disappeared along with her memories.

Despite her amnesia, Freia still harbors some traits of her former personality, such as her talent in manipulation and lying. Additionally, Freia is able to impersonate her former self flawlessly. She was able to get Kureha Clyret, the villagers and its inhabitants to turn against the Jioral Kingdom when revealing their atrocities and deceptions.

-Sestsuna. Appearance Setsuna is a short demi-human girl with blue-ish hair. While most of her body is human-like, her legs are covered in fur, her feet are wolf paws, her forearms are covered with fur. She also has a pair of lupine ears with grey ends and a large tail. Her womanly parts were described to be the same as those of humans and beautiful by Freya.

Personality After she and other members of her tribe were taken as slaves and endured harsh abuse, Setsuna has developed a strong hatred towards humans and takes great pleasure in killing Jioral Kingdom knights. Despite this, she is not willing to extend her vengeance towards innocent people.

-Eve. Appearance Eve has red eyes and a pair of black wings. After overcoming the trial of the divine bird Caladorius, Eve's hair turns silver and she gains a pair of horns.

Personality She is a little shy, not being as outspoken as the other characters. Due to being hunted, she is very distrustful of everyone she meets. While not being as vengeful as Setsuna or Keyaru, she nonetheless takes pleasure in killing the demons that killed her own tribe, showing a sadistic smile on her face.

-Ellen (Norn in the past) Appearance Norn is a beautiful pink-haired girl with green eyes. She looks similar to her older sister, albeit with a smaller figure. Many still considers her to be a beauty despite her young age and there are constant comparison and debates between her and her more endowed sister.

Personality (As Norn - past Cold and calculating, Norn is the one of the most sadistic individuals among the Jioral Kingdom, which even unnerves her fellow companions. She is also merciless towards her enemy, willing to use any tactic to ensure her victory. Deep down she is insecure as she knows she is not naturally gifted like her sister and so build up a tough reputation and persona so others respect and fear her.

Like her sister, Norn is also a coward when she doesn't even know how to defend herself due to her lacks of physical prowess. After Trist Organ and her army were wiped out as well captured by Keyaru to be tortured and raped by the "Healer Hero", she tried to justify her actions by apologizing him for the destruction of his homeland, Alban Village and the death of his love ones (including Anna) as well the demise of his friend, Karman.)

As Ellen - present After being brainwashed and having her memories wiped by Keyaru, Ellen is completely subservient to Keyaru, whom she regards as her older brother. This version of her is what she would have been if the corrupt kingdom didn’t force her to live in a terrible situation. This also made Keyaru lament and resent the Kingdom's failed system as they forced an otherwise innocent, sweet girl into becoming a corrupt and malicious individual.

-Norn. Appearance Kureha was described by Keyaru to be a natural beauty and despite having fought countless battles, she received no scars on her body. Her well proportioned body paired with her gorgeous silver hair and blue eyes could bewitched and charm even the most stoic of men and women.

Personality Unlike the majority of people affiliated with Jioral Kingdom, Kureha is an honorable woman with a strong sense of justice. She condemns all matter of wrongdoing and evildoers and willingly compromise her own safety to ensure others. When Keyaru restored her lost arm, she reacts with genuine gratitude and promised to return the favour to him someday. She abhors the concept of using the Clyret swordsmanship to commit evil, and thus confronted Keyaru after hearing how he killed the Kingdom's troops with that specific art and being told that they were innocently killed for protecting the Ice Wolf tribe. Kureha is opposed to the idea of treating demi-humans as slaves or lesser beings, as shown when she thought Setsuna was forcibly made one and attempted to save her. She carries herself with dignity everywhere she goes and can be considered spoiled since she was raised in a rich environment from young. However, she cares deeply for the commoners and gives due respect to everyone she meets. She takes great care and pride in maintaining a beautiful outward appearance and demeanour.
